description: Use this when you need the search strategy (action status: active and inactive concept blocks, the saved query per database, what each search retrieved, the latest import; detail full prints whole queries) or a record count before running (action estimate, no AI). If the researcher has not said which databases to use, ask them first: estimate without provider or providers counts nothing and returns the databases available on their plan (and the locked ones with the plan that unlocks them) to show them. estimate without query counts the saved strategy, which is what revisia_search_act run launches; a query you pass is only a what-if and the answer also gives the saved count. The count is saved, so the web app shows it without counting again. status also lists the names revisia switched off on purpose (too broad, 0 in PubMed) with the reason the web app shows. action versions: the strategy versions (v1 "Sensitive", v2 "Specific" and the researcher's own) with their PubMed query, last estimate and which one is current, and why v2 is missing when it is; launch one with revisia_search_act run version_id. Comparing and editing versions is done in the web app.

detail.description: status, versions: full prints each query whole.

provider.description: estimate: one database to count in. Leave out (with providers) to get the list to ask the researcher.

providers.description: estimate: several databases to count in, only the ones the researcher chose.

query.description: estimate: leave out to count the saved strategy (what run launches). A query given here is only a what-if.
